cues.text: Welcome. We are so glad you are here. Genuinely.
In an age of machines, the human touch has never been more valuable. We checked twice.
You bring something no system can replace. Judgement. Intuition. Presence. Mostly presence.
Every process we run is better with a person in it. Somewhere.
Your work matters. It is measured, reviewed, and appreciated. In that order.
Automation is here to help you. You are here to help automation.
Together, we are building a future that still has room for people. Several people.
Thank you for being part of it.
At the end of your week, there will be cake.
